unit_definition: routing units per 1,000,000 tokens; 100 units = 1 USD in this repository estimator
source_policy: Engineering snapshot checked against GitHub Copilot's official models-and-pricing table. Revalidate before financial reporting because rates and supported models can change.
notes: Long-context threshold selection is per model call.
When provider telemetry exposes exact context_tokens, pass it explicitly. The estimator otherwise conservatively counts fresh + cached + cache-write tokens as input context.
Pricing data is operational metadata, not a guarantee of future GitHub billing.
